name: Hero's Call Board: categories list their dailies and accepting keeps the category open
contract: The Hero's Call Board (gameobject 402000, Stormwind) answers a click with the three category options CallBoardUI binds to: PvE, Profession and PvP Quests. Choosing PvE replaces them with a single Return option and lists the PvE dailies a level-60 Human may take, among them 18017 (Culling the Felpaw, QuestSortID -380), and none of the PvP ones. Accepting 18017 through the ordinary accept packet adds it to the log and re-sends the PvE category instead of closing the window: the Return option stays and 18017 is still listed, now as a quest in progress. Return shows the three categories again, and PvP lists the battleground (81260) and duel (80651) dailies. Opening the board also verifies Path to Ascension tutorial 81, the Alliance Call Board visit.
